basis.finding: The natural M=32 strategy is exact and fast for attention output; the natural M=128 strategy is exact and within gate for QKV.

build.source: exact vllm-xpu-kernels 1e90ffa672ba02f17a909da11838a4c55b199783 with exact oneDNN 0e2a5bfeef1bfbffc3137464606540233086ce9b and ONEDNN_DEV_MODE=ON

procedure: For the four not-yet-expanded unique layer names, capture a natural full-M control with DNNL_VERBOSE=debuginfo=10.
For all six layer names and each source M, discover the natural strategy in a fresh process and normalize it exactly as R123a specifies.
Replay each strategy in a fresh process over the unchanged R123 M, prefix, permutation, repeat, padding, and timing screen.
Reuse the already captured R123/R123b attention results only if the newly discovered strategy hashes match exactly.

gates.per_shape_correctness: At least one of the two candidates must pass all five exactness checks for every production shape.
gates.per_shape_latency: The selected exact candidate must have geometric-mean candidate/control latency <=1.15 and no timed point >1.50x.
gates.selection: Among candidates passing both gates for a shape, select the lower sum of median latency across M=1,4,32,168,256. Identical K,N shapes must select the same strategy.
gates.on_all_pass: Freeze the six-shape strategy map and measured latency table, then implement a narrowly guarded non-developer oneDNN source patch and rerun the same operator suite before any model server.
gates.on_any_failure: Do not implement or launch a server; close catalog strategy pinning and proceed to a custom kernel.
gates.health: Stop immediately on any new Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, coredump, or device loss.
